50002: Software will not run, regardless of the access rights of the user.
50004: Allows programs to execute with only access to resources granted to open well-known groups, blocking access Administrator privileges, and personally granted rights.
50006: Software cannot access certain resources, such as cryptographic keys and credentials, regardless of the access rights of the user.
50008: Allows programs to execute as a user that does not have Administrator access rights, but can still access resources accessible by normal users.
50010: Software access rights are determined by the access rights of the user.
